quizGuardRationale: 肌着 compares actual 下着/シャツ uses, not an invented lower-body-only division. 鉢 compares actual ボール bowl identity, rice/tea bowlちゃわん and deep bowl丼, not every container by category.
果たして's confirmation and interrogative reality facets are separately compared with やはり/やっぱり/本当/実際/現に. An outcome or truth word is not automatically interchangeable in all constructions.
発揮's ability-display facet overlaps actual 現す/表す/示す/デモ and practical use 活用; the source exhibition gloss does not make every museum term a substitute.
バック's rear/body/background/support/reverse facets were considered against full 後ろ/裏/背中/戻る/応援/援助/支える/味方 bodies. バッグ recognizes irregularバック but the primary bag and English back entries are distinct.

発射 and 打つ overlap in firing; homophonic発車 is a different departure sense and homophony alone does not require a guard. 発想 comparisons include both アイデア andアイディア, actual thought/conception/approach uses and musical expression, not every intellectual noun.
発売 overlaps selling/販売/売る but is not inherently reduced-price特売 or every発行 issuing. 派手 is not automatically sound-volume loudness, ugly or every bright object.

話し合い discussion/conference facets overlap actual話し合う/相談/会議/会話/議論/打ち合わせ. Noun/verb and formal/informal labels alone do not establish noncompetition. 話しかける overlaps actual話す/呼ぶ addressing facets; not everysummoning orcalling use.
甚だしい extreme/excessive/severe uses overlap actual ひどい/きつい/激しい/深刻/重大, not everynegative adjective. 花嫁's bride/newlywed role overlaps actual嫁/妻 relationship uses without erasing perspective.

放れる release/detachment compares actual 離れる/外れる/取れる/抜ける/逃げる/解放/放す facets rather than one shared gloss or a transitivity exemption. ばね compares actual clock springねじ and impetusきっかけ, not springseason/泉water homonyms.
